RS Optimization v1.15.1 — Functional Utility Hotfix
• Fixes, Debloating, Networking, Game Profiles, App Optimizer and Windows Optimization now run real RS optimizations directly instead of only opening shortcuts.
• New APPLY RECOMMENDED button per channel, with an exact change preview and confirmation before anything runs.
• Live applied/not-applied state for every action.
• Clear warning before cache or temporary-file cleanup, which cannot be undone.
• Reversible registry and power-plan changes stay connected to Restore Center.
